newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Technology names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Technology names new chairman.

text.p: Sunrise Technologies International Inc said Thursday it has appointed David Light as chairman and C. Russell Trenary III as president and chief operating officer.
The chairman slot was vacant since June 1995, when the founding Chairman Arthur Vassiliadis resigned to pursue other personal and business interests.
Light was named president and chief executive officer in October 1994 and will keep his chief executive position.
Trenary joined Sunrise in May as president and chief operating officer of Laser Biotech, a unit of Sunrise.
